**Job Title: HVAC Technician**

**Location:** Chennai  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a skilled HVAC Technician with experience in piping works. The candidate will be responsible for installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of HVAC systems and piping networks.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Install, maintain, and repair HVAC systems (AC units, chillers, ducts, etc.)
* Perform piping work including installation of chilled water pipes, copper piping, and drainage lines
* Read and interpret technical drawings and layouts
* Conduct routine inspections and preventive maintenance
* Identify faults and carry out repairs in HVAC systems
* Ensure proper insulation and leak\-proof piping installation
* Follow safety standards and company procedures at site
* Coordinate with site engineers and supervisors

**Required Skills:**

* Knowledge of HVAC systems and components
* Experience in piping (GI, MS, copper, PVC)
* Ability to read drawings and technical diagrams
* Basic troubleshooting skills
